title: Floor area
text:
20.02.380 Floor area.
"Floor area" means:
1.	For nonresidential buildings or buildings containing mixed uses: the sum of the gross horizontal areas of the floors of a building measured from the exterior faces of the exterior walls or from the centerline of walls separating two buildings.
2.	For residential buildings: the sum of the gross horizontal areas of the floors of a dwelling, exclusive of garages, atriums, stairwells, open porches and unoccupied basements, cellars, and attics, measured from the exterior faces of the exterior walls.
(Ord. 16653 § 2 (part), 2007)
